projects.name: Field operations platform
projects.summary: One platform for field sales teams: dynamic forms, live tracking, and access that follows the org chart.
projects.problem: Field teams reported on paper, managers had no live view of the field, and every tier of the organization needed different access to the same data.
projects.approach: A schema-driven form engine non-technical admins can configure, hierarchical RBAC with action-level permissions, follow-up workflows with automated WhatsApp ledger sharing, and Google Maps tracking on refactored FastAPI services.
projects.result: Sales reporting went fully digital, managers see field operations as they happen, and the whole suite shares one centrally themed interface.

projects.name: AI analytics platform
projects.summary: Instagram analytics you can talk to. Ask a question, get the trend and a strategy behind it.
projects.problem: Engagement metrics are only useful when people can find the story in them. The original university dashboard showed numbers but could not explain them.
projects.approach: Re-engineered the dashboard into a SaaS platform with Module Federation, so the analytics engine deploys on its own. An LLM agent uses retrieval over a vector database to answer questions about the data.
projects.result: Cross-profile dashboards for engagement, reach, and sentiment, plus natural-language questions that turn into marketing strategies.

projects.name: YashOS
projects.summary: This portfolio. A tiny operating system with two personalities and a physics engine.
projects.problem: A portfolio can show how its maker thinks about interaction and detail, not just list a stack.
projects.approach: A window manager, a store built from small slices, and app interiors that each borrow a real app's shape. Every interaction honours reduced motion.
projects.result: The thing you are using right now. Try zero gravity from the menu bar.
